description.value: A small community library on Mayne Island, part of the Southern Gulf Islands Community Libraries network. It offers free Wi-Fi, printing services, and a quiet place to rest for cyclists exploring the Gulf Islands by ferry. The library also connects visitors to community resources including the Mayne Island Museum and Chamber of Commerce.

address.value: 411 Naylor Road, Mayne Island, BC V0N 2J2

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is the Mayne Island branch of the Southern Gulf Islands Community Libraries system, with address at 411 Naylor Road matching OSM. Phone 250-539-2597 and email MIPL@shaw.ca are confirmed on the website. Wi-Fi is supported by both the OSM tag internet_access=wlan and the website listing 'Wi-Fi & Internet Use' as a service. No evidence of bike parking, water refill, or washrooms was found on the website for the Mayne branch specifically. Note the Pender Island library is temporarily closed but there is no indication the Mayne Island branch is affected.
concerns: OSM record assigns community as 'Sidney' but the library is on Mayne Island
The sister Pender Island library is temporarily closed; no indication Mayne is affected but worth monitoring
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A community library on Mayne Island offering free Wi-Fi and a rest stop for touring cyclists exploring the Gulf Islands. Limited hours but a useful resource on a small island with few services.
